segments.comment: Source-directed cheap variation of the frozen Hill Giant route: monsters.h defines Ettin with M2_STRONG and without M2_GIANT, while role.c:character_race has no Ettin entry. polyself.c:uasmon_maxStr therefore takes the strong, non-giant, non-race STR18(100)=118 branch. The blessed potion's +1 Strength attempt should stop at that form cap; this contrasts the living Hill Giant STR19(19)=119 branch.
